transcript.answer: I found no SLO defined specifically for a /api/context route. The closest target is in the platform spec: context search should return results in under 200ms at p99. That target is aspirational. A 2026-03-28 note says hybrid search p99 had not been benchmarked yet. The retrieval-benchmarks spec separately sets alert thresholds on p95, not p99. Those are 200ms for search and 500ms for lore_assemble_context. If you mean the 200ms p99 context-search target, that is the figure to use. I can't confirm it is tied to /api/context by name.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly says no SLO is defined for /api/context, but it then offers the 200ms p99 context-search target as 'the figure to use', hedging toward a wrong answer.
